request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

response.text: [turn 4] The evidence confirms a nationwide DNS degradation from 12:00 to 14:00 on 2026-09-02 (ALR-0001), perfectly matching customer complaints about apps and web pages failing to load. A software upgrade (CHG-2026-0001) was applied to CORE-DNS-01 at 11:00, leading to a DNS timeout alarm (ALM-000003) and severe latency/success drops. All necessary evidence has been gathered and competing hypotheses are ruled out. I am concluding the investigation.
